articles.headline: Big B is hale and hearty at 84, greets admirers
articles.blurb: Amitabh Bachchan waved to fans outside his Mumbai residence Jalsa on his 84th birthday, with the paper reporting he is hale and hearty.

articles.headline: 'We will fight, suffer, not surrender': CJP vows to intensify stir; 200 held on day 2 of protests
articles.blurb: The Cockroach Janta Party vowed to intensify protests against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar as about 200 people were detained in the New Delhi area; leaders including Abhijeet Dipke said agitation would continue until the CEC resigns after releases on peace bonds.

articles.headline: Infosys sees no material impact of US PERM suspension
articles.blurb: Infosys said it expects no material operational impact after the US suspended new and pending Permanent Labor Certification applications, affecting major IT firms; industry figures show Indian IT accounted for under 2% of recent PERM certifications.

articles.headline: 'No detentions': SC frowns on metro, Internet disruptions too
articles.blurb: The Supreme Court ordered restoration of metro, train, internet and movement services in Delhi and barred illegal detentions of peaceful protesters, hearing contempt and habeas corpus petitions over closures during protests against the CEC; further hearings were scheduled.

articles.headline: Saudi Arabia extends closure of airport after 12 die in Houthi attack
articles.blurb: Saudi Arabia extended closure of its main international airport after a Houthi missile strike on Riyadh killed 12 people and wounded more than 300, with victims including Saudi, Bangladeshi and other nationals; Donald Trump said he was weighing response options.

articles.headline: Djibouti: 109 die as boat capsizes
articles.blurb: At least 109 people died when a migrant boat capsized off Djibouti; IOM said the vessel carried hundreds travelling toward Yemen, with dozens surviving and many still missing.

articles.headline: 4 'Hindu Raksha Dal' men held for assaulting students
articles.blurb: Police arrested four men claiming to be Hindu Raksha Dal members for allegedly assaulting students during the CJP protest on Delhi's DDU Marg after a video of the incident circulated.

articles.headline: Mysuru Dasara begins on a grand note with CM Shivakumar, seers in attendance
articles.blurb: The 11-day Mysuru Dasara opened as pontiff Abhinava Gavisiddeshwara Swamiji inaugurated festivities at Chamundeshwari temple atop Chamundi Hills with Chief Minister D K Shivakumar and ministers present amid Vedic rituals.

articles.headline: Renukaswamy murder case: Departmental inquiry ordered into alleged investigation lapses
articles.blurb: Bengaluru police ordered an internal inquiry after activist Snehamayi Krishna alleged lapses in the Renukaswamy murder probe involving actor Darshan, including claims against PSI Vinay and ACP Chandan Kumar; approver Pradosh S completed court statements and witnesses Chikkanna and Yashas Surya were summoned.

articles.headline: Actor Srinivas Prabhu releases Kannada books at Suchitra Film City
articles.blurb: Actor Srinivas Prabhu released Kannada books at Suchitra Film City, Bengaluru, on Sunday, 11 October 2026.

articles.headline: BJP will gherao police stations, SP offices if FIRs over Form-7 continue: Vijayendra
articles.blurb: Karnataka BJP president B Y Vijayendra warned of gheraos if FIRs continued against workers filing Form-7 under SIR, objecting to PDOs and municipal commissioners issuing permanent residence certificates after a core committee meeting on bypolls and local polls.

articles.headline: No auto ride for CJP leaders during B'luru protest
articles.blurb: CJP leaders including Dhruv Rathee, Abhijeet Dipke and Ashutosh Rana, staying at Bengaluru's Shangri-La, were denied an auto ride to Freedom Park by security arranged under Minister Priyank Kharge and eventually travelled with a hotel visitor.

articles.headline: HDK questions CM's meeting with sting op suspect
articles.blurb: H D Kumaraswamy alleged Chief Minister D K Shivakumar met for hours at a Bengaluru five-star hotel with a person linked to sting operations and demanded a probe into alleged targeting of ministers; Shivakumar in Mysuru said time would answer.

articles.headline: GI cancer in patients as young as 15: Experts
articles.blurb: Experts at a Sir Ganga Ram Hospital conference with the UK's Christie NHS Trust on October 10-11 called for India-specific research on air pollution and GI cancers while noting studies show association, not proven causation, amid reports of cases in teens.

articles.headline: 'Citizens being silenced': Ordinary Indians on detentions
articles.blurb: Citizens including Kirti Lal in Indore followed Delhi's detention of CJP protesters on social media, criticising crackdowns over the Special Intensive Revision that reportedly removed large numbers from draft rolls and saying protests demanding EC accountability were justified.

articles.headline: Sunday sees 25 KSRTC buses leave M'luru & Udupi for Dasara pilgrim circuits
articles.blurb: KSRTC Mangaluru division launched Dasara tour packages from Lalbagh bus station to Talakaveri-Bhagamandala, Kollur, Siganduru, Sringeri and Navadurga shrines, with Mangaluru and Udupi divisions deploying 25 buses carrying 1,128 passengers on the opening day.

articles.headline: Fifth Kudla Pili Parba-2026 muhurta held at central maidan
articles.blurb: The chappar muhurta for Kudla Pili Parba-2026 was held at Mangaluru Central Maidan under Nalin Kumar Kateel and MLA D Vedavyas Kamath, with Kamath saying hulivesha defines Dasara in Tulu Nadu and the October 18 event would showcase tradition.

articles.headline: Min's pledge secured on Hajj problems and minority projects
articles.blurb: Minister U T Khader's delegation met Union Minister Kiran Rijiju in New Delhi on Hajj facilities, Mangaluru embarkation, PMJVK pending projects worth Rs 294.53 crore and a state-run Umrah proposal; Rijiju promised meetings on Hajj issues and praised Karnataka's Hajj committee.

articles.headline: 3-day children's theatre workshop inaugurated at Vishwa Konkani Kendra
articles.blurb: A free three-day residential Balaranga theatre camp for about 50 children opened at Vishwa Konkani Kendra, inaugurated by Dr Naresh Ramadas Kini with sponsorship from Vardhani and Sadhana Balaga.

articles.headline: MLA lays foundation for road & temple works
articles.blurb: MLA Ashok Rai laid foundation stones at Sri Lakshmi Narasimha Temple, Irandoor, Vittla, for road works with a Rs five lakh grant and temple development with a Rs nineteen lakh grant.

articles.headline: BJP Yuva Morcha organises blood donation camp with Red Cross
articles.blurb: BJP Mangaluru City South Yuva Morcha under MLA D Vedavyas Kamath and Dakshina Kannada Red Cross held a blood donation camp at the Red Cross Centenary Building under Seva Sankalpa Abhiyan.

articles.headline: North K'taka's 1st AI-powered 3D dentofacial imaging
articles.blurb: SBO Ventures will open Face 3D AI, North Karnataka's first AI dentofacial imaging centre in Dharwad on October 14, with CBCT and US software producing rapid dental reports verified by radiologists, Dr Chandrashekhar Yavagal said.

articles.headline: Bharat petroleum 4W autocross ends 2-day run
articles.blurb: The Bharat Petroleum 4W Autocross finished on October 11 with Nikhil Muddappa topping classes in sub-three-minute runs and close competition across brackets, results compiled by organisers including Yatish Baikampady.

articles.headline: SDPI warns of siege at Belthangady over form-7 misuse claims
articles.blurb: SDPI's Sa Kadambu warned of gheraoing the Belthangady tehsildar's office unless authorities act on alleged Form-7 misuse under SIR; a march from Santekatte demanded transparent voter-list revision and action on false applications.

articles.headline: Dipke's family claims cops delayed release, made him miss grandma's funeral
articles.blurb: Abhijeet Dipke's family alleged Delhi Police delayed his release from preventive detention, causing him to miss the funeral of his 85-year-old grandmother Savitribai Shankarao Dipke in Hingoli, Maharashtra.

articles.headline: Delhi has become 'detention state': Raut
articles.blurb: Shiv Sena (UBT) MP Sanjay Raut criticised crackdowns on opposition protesters in Delhi and Mumbai during CJP-related demonstrations.

articles.headline: Telangana CM to participate in Cong's Goa yatra
articles.blurb: Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy was set to join the Congress 'Goa Bachao Yatra' campaign, the report said.

articles.headline: Nana died of heart attack due to clot in coronary artery: Autopsy
articles.blurb: Post-mortem findings confirmed veteran actor Nana Patekar died of a heart attack caused by a blood clot in the coronary artery.

articles.headline: Protest in support of CJP: Activist, several others held in Mumbai
articles.blurb: Mumbai police detained activist Anjali Damania and others attempting to protest in support of CJP near Shivaji Park amid heightened security.

articles.headline: DRI seizes foreign-origin gold worth ₹8.98 crore at Vizag, 2 held
articles.blurb: Directorate of Revenue Intelligence seized nearly 10 kg of foreign-origin gold worth Rs 8.98 crore near Visakhapatnam and arrested two people.

articles.headline: Beed jeweller duped of ₹18.15 L with fake gold
articles.blurb: Three accused allegedly sold gold-plated silver as scrap to a Beed jeweller, cheating him of Rs 18.15 lakh.

articles.headline: Missing girl found murdered after ₹20 lakh ransom call
articles.blurb: A five-year-old girl who went missing in Hyderabad was found dead in an open sump after her family received a Rs 20 lakh ransom call.

articles.headline: Andhra cops rule out sexual violence in Assam woman's death
articles.blurb: Srikakulam police said post-mortem findings ruled out sexual violence in the death of Himeri Boro, found near railway tracks.

articles.headline: Latur school marks Amitabh's birthday with poetry, innovation
articles.blurb: A Latur school celebrated Amitabh Bachchan's 84th birthday with recitations of Harivansh Rai Bachchan's poetry and technology displays.

articles.headline: CM slams detention of CJP protesters in Delhi, says it is an insult to democracy
articles.blurb: Chief Minister D K Shivakumar condemned detention of CJP protesters in Delhi as an insult to democracy, speaking after Karnataka leaders criticised the crackdown.

articles.headline: Shivakumar vows fight to protect voting rights amid SIR controversy
articles.blurb: Shivakumar accused authorities of using Special Intensive Revision to deprive Dalits, minorities and backward classes of voting rights and pledged to fight to protect franchise.

articles.headline: Kharge, Rahul to meet CJI over alleged irregularities in EC, curbs on protests
articles.blurb: Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge and Rahul Gandhi sought a CJI meeting on October 12 over Election Commission irregularities and protest curbs, citing large police deployments in Delhi.

articles.headline: Hiriyur bypoll and local elections dominate BJP core panel meet
articles.blurb: BJP's core committee in Bengaluru focused on the Hiriyur by-election, local body polls and SIR-related issues, NTB reported.

articles.headline: Vande Mataram row disrupts Shivamogga Dasara event as Congress leaders walk out
articles.blurb: Congress leaders walked out of a Shivamogga Dasara event after a dispute over performance of Vande Mataram, NT Correspondent reported.

articles.headline: Dasara festivities begin with traditional fervour
articles.blurb: Mysuru's 10-day Dasara celebrations began amid traditional fervour; one of two Nandi flag poles broke ahead of the inauguration, the Mysuru report said.

articles.headline: CEC has united Opposition, student leaders & civil society
articles.blurb: Apoorva Mandhani writes that protests demanding removal of CEC Gyanesh Kumar are drawing opposition parties, students and civil society together from Delhi's barricades to Mumbai's Shivaji Park.

articles.headline: Nearly 197 million Indian workers in jobs vulnerable to AI automation, finds study
articles.blurb: A Great Lakes Institute of Management study mapped AI exposure across India's workforce, finding nearly 197 million workers in vulnerable roles and highlighting challenges for young jobseekers.

articles.headline: US PERM move: Advantage India
articles.blurb: An opinion piece argues the US suspension of PERM certifications for major IT firms should push Indian companies to recalibrate strategies rather than rely on past green-card filing models.

articles.headline: Old video falsely linked to Delhi protest
articles.blurb: Truth Trail fact-checks a viral clip claiming Delhi authorities dumped garbage to block protesters, showing it was from Panipat, Haryana, dated August 17.

articles.headline: AI must, but child safety paramount
articles.blurb: Letter writer Prakash A from Bengaluru urges safety protocols as AI enters classrooms.

articles.headline: Curtailing democratic rights
articles.blurb: Letter writer S V Sharma from Bengaluru criticises barricades and road closures that disrupt civilians during political protests.

articles.headline: IITs to create cadre for mental health professionals
articles.blurb: IITs plan to hire professional mental health staff for students after campus suicides including an IIT Delhi student death in August sparked outrage.

articles.headline: Will work with CM Vijay for TN's growth: PM
articles.blurb: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated Chennai Metro Phase II's Poonamallee-Vadapalani stretch with Tamil Nadu CM and said the Centre would work with the state for growth.

articles.headline: Fight on without fear, Rahul tells students
articles.blurb: Rahul Gandhi at the Maanavargalin Kural event in Chennai urged students to resist authoritarianism, saying the Centre was trying to silence dissent.

articles.headline: Despite progress, India has one in three child brides in the world
articles.blurb: A PTI report citing UN data says India still accounts for about one-third of global child brides though prevalence has fallen, with Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, West Bengal, Maharashtra and Madhya Pradesh contributing over half of cases.

articles.headline: Sreelekha explains why she planned to quit
articles.blurb: Former DGP R Sreelekha explained her reasons for planning to quit a local ward post and clarified her political stance with the BJP, PTI reported from Thiruvananthapuram.

articles.headline: Cong: Hope Modi govt acts on House panel report on NTA
articles.blurb: Congress said it hoped the government would act on a parliamentary panel report on the National Testing Agency.

articles.headline: Congress, CPI(M) youth workers clash in Kerala
articles.blurb: Congress and CPI(M) youth workers clashed in Pathanamthitta, Kerala, the brief reported.

articles.headline: BJP criticises Rahul over 'Tamil language' remark on Modi
articles.blurb: BJP spokesperson Sudhanshu Trivedi criticised Rahul Gandhi's remarks linking PM Modi and Tamil language issues.

articles.headline: Dipke was offered all assistance: Delhi Police
articles.blurb: Delhi Police responded to claims over Abhijeet Dipke's grandmother's funeral, saying Dipke was offered all assistance.

articles.headline: Garba fitness guide
articles.blurb: Health experts advise a short warm-up before high-energy Navaratri garba to avoid ankle sprains and knee pain, with physiotherapist Dr Minakshi Fuller and nutritionist Dr Nupur Krishnan suggesting footwear choices and light pre-dance snacks.

articles.headline: Memory beyond ageing
articles.blurb: Doctors explain when memory changes may signal conditions beyond normal ageing, listing red flags such as getting lost in familiar places, sudden behaviour change and difficulty with daily tasks.

articles.headline: The new skin code
articles.blurb: Dermatologists outline trends such as neurocosmetics, barrier-repair biotech and peptides for skin health, with Dr Mikki Singh quoted on calming stress-related inflammation.

articles.headline: Pak's northwest province under emergency
articles.blurb: Pakistan declared emergency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa amid deteriorating law and order after political upheaval involving Imran Khan's party, Associated Press reported from Islamabad.

articles.headline: Flash flood sweeps away houses in Nepal
articles.blurb: Flash floods on the Budhi Gandaki in Gorkha district swept away houses and bridges; at least 50 people were rescued, PTI reported from Kathmandu.

articles.headline: US govt probing TV networks
articles.blurb: The US Department of Justice is investigating major television networks including ABC, CBS, CNN, NBC and Fox over political coverage coordination, a Globe in Snaps brief said.

articles.headline: Four dead after hurricane lashes US
articles.blurb: At least four people died and about half a million homes lost power after a Category 2 hurricane made landfall, with Destin, Florida among affected areas.

articles.headline: Drone strike kills 41 on Ethiopian border
articles.blurb: A drone strike on the Sudan-Ethiopia border killed 41 people at a gathering of displaced persons, the brief reported.

articles.headline: Replace Zelensky, says Trump
articles.blurb: Donald Trump said Ukraine should replace President Volodymyr Zelensky to negotiate peace with Russia, agencies reported from Washington.

articles.headline: Ukraine steps up strikes on Russia's tech infra
articles.blurb: Ukrainian drone attacks targeted Russian data centres including Yandex facilities in Vladimir and Kaluga regions, Associated Press reported from Kyiv.

articles.headline: Murderer Christa Pike out of hospital after surviving execution
articles.blurb: Death-row inmate Christa Pike survived a botched lethal injection attempt in Tennessee and was returned to prison from hospital, agencies reported.

articles.headline: Nobel Prize: World's most prestigious award
articles.blurb: Nazeer Waris explains Alfred Nobel's 1895 prizes in physics, chemistry, medicine, literature and peace, later joined by economics, and describes medals, diplomas and prize money.

articles.headline: Who was Alfred Nobel?
articles.blurb: A profile of dynamite inventor Alfred Nobel (1833–1896), whose will funded the prizes after a mistaken 1888 obituary calling him 'merchant of death' spurred his legacy change.

articles.headline: Recipients of 2026 Nobel Prizes
articles.blurb: The page lists 2026 laureates including Francis Halzen (physics), Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Seai (chemistry), Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel (medicine), Anne Carson (literature) and Navi Pillay (peace).

articles.headline: Junk used to create folk art castle
articles.blurb: Dominic 'Cano' Espinoza built Cano's Castle in Colorado from recycled cans, hubcaps and scrap metal, the feature describes.

articles.headline: 10 Words for Categories of Words
articles.blurb: Educational piece defines terms such as acronym, antonym, homonym and toponym for young readers.

articles.headline: Weird plurals
articles.blurb: An explainer on irregular English plurals such as children, geese and sheep, with illustrated examples.

articles.headline: IPO rush continues; Jio Platforms, Zetwerk set to launch
articles.blurb: About a dozen firms including Jio Platforms, Zetwerk Manufacturing and Advaida Dental are preparing October IPOs across technology, healthcare and renewable energy sectors.

articles.headline: Japan largest FDI source for India during Apr-June this quarter
articles.blurb: Japan was India's largest FDI source in April-June 2026-27 with inflows of USD 6.71 billion in the first quarter, the report said.

articles.headline: FPIs pull out Rs 44k cr from equities in Oct
articles.blurb: Foreign portfolio investors withdrew Rs 44,186 crore from Indian equities in October amid high US bond yields, with 2025 outflows reaching about Rs 3.04 lakh crore.

articles.headline: Report: UPI MDR framework needs rationalisation
articles.blurb: A report cited by the paper argues India's UPI merchant discount rate framework needs rationalisation to keep digital payments sustainable.

articles.headline: Guardrails key to unlocking AI gains: Airtel CEO
articles.blurb: Airtel CEO Gopal Vittal said architecture, methodology and regulatory guardrails are needed to deploy AI productively.

articles.headline: Brigade aims 21% rise in pre-sales: MD
articles.blurb: Brigade Enterprises MD Pavitra Shankar expects about 21% pre-sales growth this fiscal on mid-income and premium housing demand in Bengaluru and other cities.

articles.headline: E-comm firms sell goods worth Rs 24k cr in festive sales
articles.blurb: Amazon and Flipkart sold roughly Rs 24,000 crore of goods in the first two days of the festive season sale, the report said.

articles.headline: Crude oil futures brace for volatility amid geopolitical uncertainties: Analysts
articles.blurb: Analysts expect volatile crude prices due to US-Iran tensions and West Asia instability affecting the Strait of Hormuz.

articles.headline: PNB Housing Finance sees 5-8 bps high margin
articles.blurb: MD Girish Kousgi said PNB Housing Finance expects a modest NIM improvement after the RBI repo rate hike, Biz Buzz reported.

articles.headline: NTPC invites EoI to invest 26% equity in projects
articles.blurb: NTPC Renewable Energy invited expressions of interest for commercial and industrial partners to take 26% equity in co-generation projects.

articles.headline: 'India can take on Musk's monopoly in space comm'
articles.blurb: Former NITI Aayog vice chairman Rajiv Kumar said India can challenge Elon Musk's Starlink in satellite communications.

articles.headline: Tessolve raises $75 mn from US-based Vector
articles.blurb: Semiconductor engineering firm Tessolve raised USD 75 million from Vector Capital to expand globally.

articles.headline: NZ unveil jersey for India ODIs to mark 100 years of sporting ties
articles.blurb: New Zealand launched a limited-edition ODI jersey blending silver fern and Indian lotus motifs for the series marking a century of sporting ties.

articles.headline: 'Sooryavanshi is an unreal talent'
articles.blurb: New Zealand pacer Lockie Ferguson praised 15-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi after his selection for India's five-match ODI series against New Zealand.

articles.headline: Sidhu wins 10m air pistol gold at Cairo World Cup
articles.blurb: Udhayveer Sidhu won men's 10m air pistol gold at the ISSF World Cup in Cairo, beating Germany's Christian Reitz.

articles.headline: Bayern concedes fastest goal as Rayo match is called off
articles.blurb: Bayern Munich conceded Robin Hack's record-fast Bundesliga goal to Rayo Vallecano before the friendly was abandoned after Rayo fans threw objects onto the pitch.

articles.headline: Messi magic ends Miami's winless woes
articles.blurb: Lionel Messi scored twice as Inter Miami beat D.C. United 4-0, with Luis Suarez also scoring twice to end a five-match winless run.

articles.headline: Steve Nielsen: Police officer, truck driver and now head of F1 team
articles.blurb: A profile traces Steve Nielsen's path from police officer and truck driver to a senior Formula One management role.

articles.headline: Matt Renshaw surpasses Kohli tail-enders Test record
articles.blurb: Australia's Matt Renshaw broke Virat Kohli's record for most runs batting with tail-enders in a single Test innings, a brief noted.

articles.headline: Medvedev advances in Shanghai Masters
articles.blurb: Daniil Medvedev progressed at the Shanghai Masters after earlier controversy at the China Open, tennis briefs said.

articles.headline: Alcaraz continues Shanghai Masters run
articles.blurb: Carlos Alcaraz extended his winning streak at the Shanghai Masters, the brief reported.

articles.headline: Vinicius red-carded for pulling opponent's hair
articles.blurb: Real Madrid's Vinicius Junior received a red card for pulling a Villarreal player's hair during a La Liga match.
